instruction: Use Drone with status: changed trigger
output: echo 'steps: - name: notify image: plugins/slack settings: webhook: https://hooks.slack.com when: status: - changed' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with branch filter on push
output: echo 'steps: - name: build image: golang commands: - go build when: branch: - main - develop event: - push' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: test image: golang commands: - go test when: branch: exclude: - gh-pages' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: deploy image: alpine commands: - echo deploy when: target: - production - staging' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone debug mode in pipeline
output: echo 'kind: pipeline name: debug steps: - name: shell image: alpine commands: - sleep 3600' > .drone.yml

instruction: Create a Drone pipeline with YAML anchors
output: echo 'steps: - name: shared image: alpine &step template: - name: foo commands: - echo bar steps: - name: use-anchor <<: *step' >> .drone.yml
woodpecker-cli secret add owner/repo MY_SECRET value
woodpecker-cli cron create owner/repo nightly '@daily' --branch main
echo 'pipeline: build: image: golang:latest commands: - go build - go test' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Create a Woodpecker pipeline with multiple steps
output: echo 'pipeline: build: image: golang:latest commands: - go build test: image: golang:latest commands: - go test depends_on: - build' > .woodpecker.yml
